scene: You step off the night bus into the glowing, hum of Moonlit Laundromat.
picture: A flat side view of Moonlit Laundromat. Far left sits an orange sleeping cat on a blue chair. The player stands left in a yellow raincoat and green boots holding a red umbrella. Centre shows a glowing, spinning dryer. Right is a metal soap dispenser. Far right, the night bus waits outside open glass doors.
shown: a fluffy orange cat asleep on a low plastic chair on the far left
a brightly spinning dryer door glowing with purple light in the centre
a vintage metal soap vending machine mounted on the wall to the right

variants.scene: The warm air inside smells of clean laundry and quiet midnight rain.
You shake your red umbrella dry, hum {tune}, and glance around the room.
Tumble dryers whirl cheerfully under bright lights as your green boots squeak inside.
